title: The What the Owl Call Is Not
youtube_title: The What the Owl Call Is Not | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Listening all the way through is a gift you can give today.
summary: At a kitchen table before breakfast, chairs close, Mama begins to tell Niko about what an owl call is not, which took a while to explain. Niko wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
